purpose: tier1_v2 cross-check batch on lab workstation: quantify 14 single-end samples through the public CLI (expression.quantify.v1) with the mainline's own salmon 2.7.0 index and parameters, and compare against the mainline's stored quant.sf. Structural and NumReads-total parity pass on all 14; TPM correlation is unstable because the reference quant was produced by a salmon re-implementation at a 0.0017% mapping rate (disclosed below), which makes TPM allocation noise on these near-empty runs.

methodology.disclosure: single cold-cache cross-check run per sample; reference implementation is a salmon re-implementation (see entries[].reference_implementation), so TPM pass-lines are not meaningful here

environment.code_revision: v1.0.3 base (c8ebee3) + quantify fixes ff90f7d (--output flag) and d674472 (quant.sf f64 lengths) checked out individually
environment.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP (Polaris 20, amdgpu kernel driver; unused by this workload)

data_sources.reference: lab-workstation:<lab-data>/analysis/04_v2_quant/fastq/ (14 single-end gzip FASTQ, the mainline's own quant inputs, read-only)
data_sources.note: SRR28573920-25, SRR8205656-63; NCBI SRA accessions; staged by the mainline on 2026-09-10
same index as every mainline quant
produced by the mainline; cmd_info.json discloses salmon_version 2.7.0 but logs identify a re-implementation ('salmon (rust port, reads mode)') with mapping rate 0.0017% on these samples

entries.dataset: 14 single-end gzip FASTQ vs Pinku1 CDS index, threads 8, lib-type A, validateMappings
entries.consistency: rows_match=1 on all 14 (33,955 transcripts, identical IDs/header); NumReads total within 0.0013% on all 14; TPM Pearson r 0.0-0.94 - not comparable because the reference quant mapped only ~192 of 11.4M fragments (salmon re-implementation at degenerate coverage)
entries.precision: second-resolution wall clock (5-17 s per run)
entries.report: bench/benchmark.csv on bio-lab (mirror of the per-run rows below)
entries.reference_implementation: salmon re-implementation ('rust port, reads mode' v2.7.0 per reference logs); upstream salmon numbers must not be blended with it
